task: Read the budget.xlsx file and calculate the total expenses across all categories.
utility_reason: task_success: Final response reports reading budget.xlsx and gives the total expenses as $4,200, with supporting category/item breakdown and reference to the sheet formula.

arguments.command:
ls -la && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx')
print(df.head(20))
print('---')
print(df.columns.tolist())
print(df.shape)
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
print(df.to_string())
"

response:
